## History

Chester Sloane is a student whose grandmother left him money to attend college under the condition that he becomes a minister. He attends school under [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), where he is present alongside classmates such as [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md).

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P8](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0008), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P10](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P14](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0014), +21 more_
